parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Only return batches with this status.

parameters.name: container_id
parameters.description: Only return batches grown in this jar or tray.

post.summary:
Start a batch. The server copies the plant's current definition into the batch and
schedules the first step's tasks.

409.description: The jar or tray holds another active batch (`container_in_use`)

post.summary: Stop an active batch early, for example because it molded.
Log what a harvested batch yielded. Log again for a second cut.

get.summary: List every jar and tray in the household, unarchived ones first.

post.summary: Add a jar or tray for the whole household.

422.description: The name is empty, too long, or taken

delete.summary: Delete a jar or tray that has never held a batch. Archive one with history instead.

patch.summary: Rename, edit, archive, or restore a jar or tray.

409.description: Archiving a container with an active batch (`container_in_use`)

delete.summary: Delete a harvest logged by mistake.

patch.summary: Change your timezone or quiet hours.

get.summary: List every plant: built-in ones, custom ones, and custom overrides of built-in ones.

put.summary:
Create or replace a custom plant. Using a built-in slug overrides the built-in plant for
everyone on the server.

400.description: The body isn't a plant definition

delete.summary:
Delete a custom plant. For an override, the built-in plant comes back. Running batches keep
their copy of the definition.

404.description: No custom plant has this slug

post.summary: Save this device's push subscription, so reminders reach it.

delete.summary: Stop sending reminders to this device.

post.summary: Send a test notification to all of your devices.

409.description: Push notifications are off on this server (`push_disabled`)

get.summary: Your results per plant: yield per gram of seed, ratings, and days to harvest.
List open tasks on your active batches, soonest first.

parameters.name: due_before
parameters.description: Only return tasks due at or before this time, like the end of the user's day.

post.summary:
Mark a task done. Finishing a care task schedules the next one. Finishing an advance task
moves the batch into its next step, and moving into harvest ends the batch.

parameters.name: done_at
parameters.description:
When it was done, for ticks made offline that sync later. Defaults to now. At most a week
ago, and not in the future.

409.description: The task is already done (`task_done`), or its batch has moved on (`batch_not_active`, `stale_task`)

422.description: `done_at` is in the future or more than a week ago

post.summary: Push a task back. You get a new reminder when the snooze ends.

409.description: The task is done or its batch has ended

422.description: The time is in the past or more than a week away

plant.description: The plant definition as it was when the batch started.

steps.description: The steps the batch has been in, with actual times.

upcoming.description: Planned windows from the current step to harvest. Empty unless the batch is active.

oneOf.description:
When the batch should be ready, counted from when the current step actually started. Only
set for active batches.

batch_count.description: How many batches this container has held, across the household.

color.description: Lowercase `#rrggbb`, or none for clear glass and uncoloured trays.

oneOf.description: The batch growing in it right now, if any.

container_id.description: The jar or tray to grow in. It must not be archived or hold another active batch.

seed_g.description: Seed weight in grams. Defaults to the plant's `seed_g`.

started_at.description: When the first step started. Defaults to now. Can't be in the future.

color.description: A colour like `#3b82f6`. Leave it out for clear glass.

name.description: Unique in the household, ignoring case.

ErrorBody.description: The body of every error response.

problems.description: For `invalid`, what's wrong with each field.

Occupant.description:
The active batch in a container. Another household member's batch shows who grows it, but
not its id, because batches are private to their owner.

batch_id.description: Set when the batch is yours, so you can link to it.

seed_g.description: Suggested seed weight for one jar or tray, in grams.

PlantStats.description: How one plant has done for a user, over harvested batches with at least one harvest logged.

average_days.description: From the batch's start to its first harvest.

average_rating.description: Over harvests that have a rating.

yield_ratio.description: Grams harvested per gram of seed.

Problem.description: One thing wrong with a plant definition. `path` points at the field, like `steps[1].care[0]`.

public_key.description:
The VAPID public key, as base64url, for `pushManager.subscribe`. Null when push
notifications are off on this server.

QuietHours.description: Quiet hours in a user's local time. `end` before `start` means they run past midnight.

Slug.description:
A plant's id, like `mung-bean`. Lowercase letters, digits, and single hyphens, at most 64
characters.

until.description: When to remind you again. Within the next week.

care.description: Chores that repeat while the batch is in this step.

duration_max.description: When the step is overdue. Leave it out for a step with a fixed length.

duration_min.description: When the step can end at the earliest. Required for every step except harvest.

StepWindow.description: When a step should start if every step before it takes its shortest or longest time.

oneOf.description: Move the batch into the next step, whose action this is.

action.description: Move the batch into the next step, whose action this is.

snoozed_until.description: Set while the task is snoozed. `due_at` already counts the snooze.

removed.description: Subscriptions removed because the push service no longer knows them.

sent.description: Devices the push service accepted the message for.

UpdateContainer.description: Fields to change. Leave a field out to keep it.

archived.description: Archive or restore. Archived containers can't take new batches.

color.description: A colour like `#3b82f6`, or null to remove it.

UpdateMe.description:
Settings to change. Leave a field out to keep it. Send `"quiet_hours": null` to turn quiet
hours off.

oneOf.description: When reminders wait, in local time. None means they can arrive any time.

timezone.description: An IANA timezone, like `Europe/Budapest`. Quiet hours and "today" follow it.

tags.name: containers
tags.description: Jars and trays, shared by the household
